info.name: School Management - Parent APK API
info.description:
Parent APK backend, organised like the app (same shape as the Teacher/Student APK collections): an ⌂ App bar (top-right 🔔 notifications + 👤 profile) and 5 bottom-nav tabs — Home · Academics · Attendance · Notices · Profile.

A parent may have MULTIPLE children — pick one with "Home / 03 - Children / List" (stores {{childId}}); every child-scoped call is authorized server-side against the ParentStudent link (childId from the request is never trusted). Fees / Payments / Receipts / Pickup / Settings open from the Profile tab. Transport & 1:1 Communication are DEFERRED in v1.

baseUrl points straight at platform-service (default http://localhost:5002); no /api/v1/platform prefix (the api-gateway on :8080 adds it). Collection-level Bearer {{accessToken}}.

RUN ORDER: "00 - Environment / Health" → "📱 Tab 5 · Profile / 01 - Auth / Login (parent)" (stores accessToken/parentId/schoolId + first childId) → "📱 Tab 1 · Home / 03 - Children / List" → any tab.
